“Mydeimos, my beloved,” Phainon practically purred out his words as he moved into the living room, “I got you a gift today.”

Of course he got Mydei a gift - he usually did. Mydei was the person most dear to him, it was only correct that when he saw things that reminded him of Mydei that he bought them for Mydei. At least, if he thought Mydei would enjoy it for himself.

This time, however, this was specifically ordered. Something Phainon sought out for his own curiosity and rampant desire when he looked at the beautiful man.

Stunning, gorgeous, jaw dropping, museum worthy.. All things could describe the man Phainon was lucky enough to call his husband.

All things to describe the lounging man who was sprawled on their couch - belly down as he laid there with his gaze focused on his art tablet. Only to flick his eyes up over Phainon entering the room with a rather adorable expression on his face - one of pure wonder and curiosity.

He really was very cat adjacent.. 

“Oh? And what is it?” Mydei asked before swinging his feet over the side of the couch - lazily sitting upwards as he tilted his head to the side. And Phainon thought it was utterly endearing how Mydei was trying not to blatantly stare at the box in Phainon’s hands - yet clearly wanted to as those golden hued eyes flickered about both of them.

Phainon couldn’t help but give a lop-sided smile to him over that, “Heh.. Well, I guess you have to open it and find out!”

Those were the words Phainon said as he approached that blonde and red fiery haired man, his cute braid always at the side of his hair - no matter if he had it up in a small ponytail it always persevered. 

Phainon loved everything about this man. 

The small amount of stubble he grew in his sleep to shave off in the morning made Phainon want to kiss him even more in those small hours of the day. The way he lounged around like a cat sometimes made Phainon debate spending hours brushing back Mydei’s hair for him lovingly..

Everything about him made Phainon’s brain stall - and somehow, as Phainon held out that small box and looked at the golden ring on his own finger. Somehow.

Mydei was all his. 

Mydei took the box however, gently and slowly as he gave a small stretch and yawn - making Phainon catch a glimpse of those oddly long and sharp canines his husband had.

Cute.

His husband is so painfully cute.

Mydei was clueless about any of those thoughts, instead focusing on opening the little gift box - only. Mydei froze as he took the lid off, not taking more than a moment to look at it in that box before slowly fishing it out.

“This is..” Mydei trailed off, clearly stunned as his golden eyes narrowed towards the leather he was slowly picking up, “A collar..?”

Phainon couldn’t help but beam as he watched that pink leather be picked up by Mydei - clearly stunned as he seemed to act like the collar was on fire for himself, barely touching it much. Even that was endearing to Phainon.

“Mhm!” Phainon hummed as his husband looked between the collar and Phainon, clearly baffled as his jaw seemed to twitch and tick slowly. Evidently trying to figure out how to reply to this.

“For..? Are we getting a pet?” Was Mydei’s thrilling question, one that made Phainon beam just a little bit more as Mydei stared upwards at him from his seat on the couch - appearing less than amused. More.. Concerned.

And maybe he was right for that!

“No, silly. It’s for you.” Phainon informed him, and the way Mydei’s eyes didn’t move away from Phainon’s own made Phainon even more giddy.

He loved when his husband was stunned into silence, just as much as he loved hearing everything he had to say.

He may just really like his husband, it was up for debate though!

“For.. Me?” Mydei eventually did echo once he managed to tear his eyes away from Phainon, only to look at the collar in his hand.  And Phainon.. Really, really, wanted to see Mydei wearing it.

His husband was always beautiful and something Phainon would talk about no matter what, but the idea of his strong husband wearing a cute pink collar that had built in lace and a single silver bell on it.. Well, Phainon almost felt dizzy even imagining such a sight of Mydei in his low cut shirts and sweatpants for lounging around the house with such a precious accessory on..

“You really like my collar, I think you’ll enjoy having your own too.” Phainon told him with a rather smug smile crawling onto his lips as he watched his husband set it back into the box - still acting as if it could actually bite him before looking at Phainon.

“I..” Mydei took in an audible breath at that, loudly and painfully sounding as he tried to get a grip on his emotions (something Phainon was very familiar with after sixteen years of friendship, two years of dating, and three of marriage, mind you.), “Your collar is different, I like yanking you around.” 

“My own collar is..” Mydei trailed off, knitting his brows as an expression of rather deep contemplation seemed to cover his face silently. As if this matter was truly something for him to consider, and that, that brief window of considering actually wearing it.

That was enough for Phainon to know his husband would indulge him, that Mydei would wear that collar if he begged him enough. After all, Mydei did like his puppy to beg, he told him that much in bed.

“I won’t be yanking you around with it, pretty boy. I just think..” Phainon immediately moved closer, diving to his own knees to be just a little bit shorter than Mydei sitting on the couch, “Your neck would look so cute with it on..”

Those golden eyes narrowed at that - clearly debating biting back against this idea, but the fact his mouth was twitching and he seemed to be struggling to think of his words.. Phainon knew his beloved was trapped. 

He knew Mydei like the back of his hand.

He was a giant overgrown lion, fierce and assertive, standing his ground and speaking his mind on his beliefs. Yet Mydei had one giant vulnerability.. Mydei really did love Phainon. 

And Phainon.. Really wanted to see Mydei with a cute jingling collar on him. 

“You’re already so cute without a collar, but look at it!” Phainon started as he instead crawled even closer to his husband, resting his head on his knee and praying that he looked adorable enough to win Mydei over on this matter.

But Mydei still sat there staring downwards at him - eyes narrowed as Phainon moved his head on Mydei’s knee, resting his cheek against it with a small pout.

“Come on.. I’ll even put it on you.” Phainon murmured, words a bit slurred as he slowly nuzzled his face against Mydei’s pant leg slowly. 

Mydei leaned back slightly at that with a heavy sigh, his eyes flicking to the box that he had already set to the side lacking his art tablet, “If we weren’t married, I would be strangling you for even buying this with me in mind.”

Phainon couldn’t help the way his hands grabbed at Mydei’s leg, massaging beneath his knee a bit idly, nearly debating if he should start whimpering.

Mydei liked it when he whimpered..

“It’s because we’re married that I know you’ll enjoy it..” Phainon tried to argue, trying his best to reel in his derailing thoughts of how Mydei did like to leash and yank on his collar while he whined like a dog. That wasn’t important right now.

What was important was the way those sunset eyes still seemed so very uncertain - still hovering with the chance that Phainon could convince him to put the collar on. 

“Hmph.” Was Phainon’s stunning husband’s reply, a quiet thing, and one that Mydei enjoyed doing rather often.

But Phainon always saw it for what it really was.

It wasn’t a ‘no’.

Phainon gave a small whine, slowly rubbing his head a bit harder on Mydei’s knee; “Come on beautiful..”

Mydei gave him a heavy scowl over those words before his face lightened, sighing audibly and he closed his eyes for a moment, “Do as you please.”

And Phainon had never moved so quickly to grab that little red gift box, and fish out that collar that now loudly jingled over his quickened movements; “Thank you, thank you..” Those words were like a prayer, a praise of Mydei’s patience but..

“.. It has a bell.” Mydei noted over the noise, and Phainon couldn’t help but let out an amused huff of laughter - a small snort over it.

Of course it had a bell, Phainon wanted to hear it jingle while resting on Mydei’s neck - wanted to know when Mydei was moving around. And especially wanted to hear it during sex.. 

Eventually, if Mydei would even wear it during sex, at least.. But Mydei was many things, one thing he certainly was was someone that enabled Phainon. Always had been, and, sure maybe there were some instances of Phainon abusing that, sure, sure. But it was always with good intentions!

Mydei could let loose sometimes and just indulge in fun little activities, in Phainon’s opinion!

“My little cat.” Phainon said without a thought - mainly because he had always thought that about Mydei. Even while growing up, he was such a cat that it was endearing to Phainon. Even when they were just ‘friends’ Mydei would fall asleep leaning on him if Phainon was petting his head enough - curled into him so enchantingly.

“.. Pardon?” Mydei asked, at that, Phainon didn’t waste a single second as he unhooked that cutesy frilly collar, his hands almost shaking from the pure excitement of putting such a thing on his beloved. 

“If I’m your dog, then you’re my cat, isn’t that fair?” Phainon asked as he straightened himself out a bit, just enough to move closer to Mydei’s neck and ghost his fingers across the fragile skin there.

Skin he had bitten a hundred times before and been muzzled due to Mydei grumbling things like ‘I have to record a video tomorrow’. Why did that even matter?! The entire world should know the faceless handsome cook belonged all to Phainon.

Even if he wore his wedding ring in videos, Phainon wanted to flaunt it more!

Anyway, Phainon’s hands moved slowly, gently pressing on that neck in a tease - he wasn’t shocked Mydei was somewhat okay with a collar. He had quite the fondness for being choked, the idea of him liking a little bit of pressure hauntingly on his neck wasn’t that odd. Even if it was by a very adorable collar that jingled so sweetly.

“You like being a dog. You put those silly ears and collar on yourself, not me.” Mydei reminded him, but Phainon could only focus on how his Adam’s apple bobbed with his words - those golden eyes staring upwards at him as Phainon clicked the collar firmly onto his neck. Latching it on there snuggly. 

“Mhm.. Is this a bad time to say I bought ears and a tail for you as well?” Phainon asked as he stepped away very slightly - just enough to inspect his work and the sight did not disappoint. Especially as Mydei’s hand raised to his own neck slowly to caress it tenderly, obviously trying to get a read on it himself.

But such a tight and adorable collar.. It fit his husband so well..

Phainon desperately wanted to put the tail in him.

“What?” Mydei asked, utterly oblivious to those feelings as he dropped his hand as soon as his index finger grazed that bell - causing a sweet and quiet little jingle to sound off.

Embarrassed.

Phainon knew that sound embarrassed him just by how those eyes dipped down instantly, no longer staring Phainon in the eyes.

Cute.

Cute, everything about his husband was so very damn cute.

“They were so cute.. I saw them and thought of you immediately..” Phainon confessed, trying to reel in his derailing thoughts of how he wanted to kiss this man senseless - he had a job to complete here!

Mydei blinked once at that before flitting his eyes back to focus on Phainon, “Right.. And you expect me to wear them as well?”

Phainon didn’t miss a beat, tossing his head to the side to give a small pout, lowering himself back to the ground between Mydei’s legs, “Would you please..?”

Mydei considered him for a moment, just a brief second before a small found its way to Mydei’s face - the gentlest of upturns in his lips before he said that ever familiar word that Phainon had heard so many times before;

Phainon sighed at that, loudly and very dramatically, mainly due to the fact he knew he would beg. He would do anything Mydei wanted him to do, after all..
